title: Kyoya and Photobooks
statementMd:
Kyoya Ootori is selling photobooks of the Ouran High School Host Club. He has 26 photos, labeled "a" to "z", and he has compiled them into a photo booklet with some photos in some order (possibly with some photos being duplicated). A photo booklet can be described as a string of lowercase letters, consisting of the photos in the booklet in order. He now wants to sell some "special edition" photobooks, each with one extra photo inserted anywhere in the book. He wants to make as many distinct photobooks as possible, so he can make more money. He asks Haruhi, how many distinct photobooks can he make by inserting one extra photo into the photobook he already has?

Please help Haruhi solve this problem.

## Input

The first line of input will be a single string $*s*$ ($1 ≤ |*s*| ≤ 20$). String $*s*$ consists only of lowercase English letters.

## Output

Output a single integer equal to the number of distinct photobooks Kyoya Ootori can make.

## Note

In the first case, we can make '`ab`','`ac`',$...$,'`az`','`ba`','`ca`',$...$,'`za`', and '`aa`', producing a total of 51 distinct photo booklets.
statementZhMd:
Kyoya Ootori 正在出售樱兰高校男公关部的相册。他有 26 张照片，分别标记为 "a" 到 "z"，并将其中一些照片按某种顺序编成了一本相册（某些照片可能重复出现）。一本相册可以表示为一个由小写字母组成的字符串，字符串中的字母顺序即为相册中照片的顺序。现在，他想制作一些“特别版”相册，每本都在原有相册中的任意位置插入一张额外的照片。他希望制作出尽可能多的不同相册，这样就能赚更多的钱。因此，他向 Haruhi 询问：通过在已有相册中插入一张额外的照片，他能制作出多少本不同的相册？

请帮助 Haruhi 解决这个问题。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个字符串 $*s*$（$1 ≤ |*s*| ≤ 20$）。字符串 $*s*$ 仅由小写英文字母组成。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示 Kyoya Ootori 能制作出的不同相册的数量。

## 说明

在第一个情况中，我们可以制作 '`ab`'、'`ac`'、$...$、'`az`'、'`ba`'、'`ca`'、$...$、'`za`' 以及 '`aa`'，总共得到 51 本不同的相册。
